 Order

The present Appeal has been filed on behalf of the Appellant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the award dated 07.05.2024 [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"] passed by learned MACT (Central), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.

The challenge in the present Appeal is for enhancement of the amount of compensation awarded in the sum of Rs.49,79,840/-
along with 8% interest per annum.
2. Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits the grounds for challenge in the present Appeal are two-fold i.e., for calculation of pecuniary and non- pecuniary losses.

3. Learned Counsel for the Appellant also submits that the disability certificate could not be placed on record before the learned Tribunal since it was made available to the Appellant after the Impugned Award was passed.
